title: GreenPan Nova 10-Piece Cookware Pots & Pans Set, Oprah’s Favorite Things 2024, PFAS-Free Ceramic Nonstick, Fry, Sauté, Stockpot, Utensils, Lids, Induction Suitable, Dishwasher & Oven Safe, Deep Teal

reviews.title: Unbelievable quality
reviews.body: My deep aqua pans are actually blue but I was able to overlook that fact because you can’t beat the price for these high quality heavy pans.My first meal I made was rice and gandules. The heat distribution was fantastic. The clean up a breeze. I followed the instructions and sprayed the pan with garlic infused olive oil and not one grain of rice stuck or burned.To my Puerto Rican friends who enjoy the burnt rice on the bottom this is not your pan/pot.  I never liked the burnt crunchy rice on the bottom so this is the perfect set for me. The cleanup was unbelievably easy. Just sprayed with dish soap and wiped it with clean fiber cloth. It took less than a minutes time. I highly recommend.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on March 18, 2026
reviews.author: Marie Carter

reviews.title: Love my new cooking set!
reviews.body: I'm in love with this pot set. I get compliments b/c they're beautiful, but that doesn't even matter. What matters is how they cook! They absorb heat and distribute in the best way possible. Nonstick, easy to clean, and heavy duty. I've used them daily, the multiple sizes are perfect, not too many extra pots and lids that arent used like other bundles. Great for the price! They're very sturdy, so I don't worry about them scratching or denting, thicker material not like the flimsy cheap pans.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on July 8, 2025

reviews.title: Good price for non toxic pan set
reviews.body: Have had these pans for 6 months. Not as durable as the regular nonstick but they are good for price point. They do lose their nonstick but I cook with butter and that seems to help. For the price and being non toxic I think they are a good price point and a good knock off from caraway. I have the white color and they are super cute!

reviews.body: Incredible! All of my nonstick pans were scratched and I replaced them with these. I should have done this years ago!! They heat evenly and NOTHING sticks to them. Cleaning is so easy; these pans are a dream. I also love the bright color options.

reviews.author: NL

reviews.title: You have to baby these pans.
reviews.body: I was so excited to get new pans because our old ones were Teflon and it was flaking off so I was worried we were giving ourselves cancer by continuing to use them. When these pans arrived I carefully read the instructions and explained everything to my husband. He was very annoyed that there were so many rules. Heat the pan for about 90 seconds with nothing in it before using. Use lower heat. Use minimal oil. Don't use anything abrasive to clean them - only the soft side of a sponge. So we did our best to follow the rules, and at first the pans were great. (Although from day 1 I have hated the solid color lids. Glass lids to be able to see into the pans is so much nicer. Plus these get hot so you need to use a pot holder to lift the lids off, which is annoying.) At first we could cook things that used to stick to our old pans and the food didn't stick. They were so easy to clean. But now, after 6 months, I dread using the saute and frying pans. I guess the small amount of oil we have used has been too much and/or the heat has been too high, despite our best efforts to follow the stated rules of how to use these, and now they are a nightmare to clean. I have no choice but to try to scrub them with the back of the sponge - which STILL doesn't get the residue off no matter how much muscle I put into it. I want some pans that won't give me cancer that I don't have to treat so carefully!!
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on June 7, 2025
reviews.author: Nic

reviews.title: Honest review- quality product on heavier side for elderly
reviews.body: Honest review!Slightly heavier for elderly/ seniors other than that, I don’t have any concerns.It’s a great quality product and I’m overall happy. Also, the blue color is beautiful.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on March 15, 2026

features: Featured in Oprah's Favorite Things 2024: “Know someone setting up their first home? This collection of five pots and pans is PFAS-free, comes with lids, a large spoon, and a spatula—and will have anyone cooking in no time. (And thanks to the nonstick formula, very little oil is needed.)”
COOKWARE SET INCLUDES: 3.26QT Saucepan with Lid, 6.61QT Stockpot with Lid, 8” Frypan, 10” Frypan, 5.11QT Sauté Pan, Silicone Solid Spoon, Silicone Turner, 2x Pan Protectors, Wonder Sponge
REINFORCED WITH DIAMONDS: GreenPan's original diamond-infused nonstick coating offers remarkable durability, balanced heating, and effortless cleanup.
TOXIN-FREE: GreenPan's Thermolon healthy ceramic nonstick coating is free of PFAS, PFOA, lead, and cadmium.
QUICK-HEATING: The heavy-duty construction offers extreme strength with quick and even heating every single time.
INDUCTION READY: The innovative induction base delivers uniform heat distribution on all cooktops: induction, gas, electric, halogen or ceramic.
ULTRA-TOUGH LIDS: The forged lids provides extra strength and feature a divot that doubles as a utensil rest to minimize contact with a hot lid.
BUILT FOR OVEN COOKING: Oven and broiler safe up to 600°F and suitable for all stovetops, including induction.
ERGONOMIC HANDLES: The riveted stainless steel handles offer a sturdy, comfortable grip.
DISHWASHER SAFE: These pans are dishwasher safe for easy cleanup, but most messes will wipe clean.
